objective: max real-specificity subject to AI-recall >= min_recall
tuning_note: Fitted on the validation split only, flip-averaged, with the objective 'maximise real-photo specificity subject to AI-recall >= 0.90'. That encodes the stated preference that a real photo wrongly flagged as AI is the more costly error, with missed AI images acceptable up to about 10%. Plain accuracy was the wrong objective because it treats both mistakes as equally expensive. The holdout sets played no part in choosing this value.
